title: Steady Card Use Allowance on Portal Credit-Card Payments, Placed Consumer Accounts
content:
Cashiering standard clause for **Placed Consumer Accounts** on the portal credit-card steady-use allowance, earned by recent card payments on an account whose card payments have never come back.

## Clause

The portal credit-card steady-use allowance is **$150.00** where 2 or more card payments, debit or credit, were received in the last three months and no card payment on the account was ever returned; **$75.00** where exactly one card payment was received in the last three months and no card payment on the account was ever returned; and **nothing** where no card payment was received in the last three months or a card payment on the account was ever returned.

The allowance is added, at its full amount, in working out the portal credit-card ceiling of the day.

## Elements of the clause

| Element | Meaning |
|---|---|
| Card payment | A consumer payment posted on the account's money history through the debit-card or credit-card channel |
| Received in the last three months | Fewer than three whole calendar months separate its date from the handling date, a whole month being reached on the same day of a later month; a payment dated the handling date itself is included |
| A card payment ever returned | A returned-payment entry on the account, at any date, for a debit-card or credit-card payment |

## Condition table

| Card payments in the last three months | Card payment ever returned | Allowance |
|---|---|---|
| 2 or more | No | $150.00 |
| Exactly 1 | No | $75.00 |
| 0 | No | nothing |
| any | Yes | nothing |

## Hypothetical cases

*Invented histories, handling date 2026-10-10.*

- Credit-card payment on 2026-08-01 and debit-card payment on 2026-10-10; no card return ever: two card payments, allowance $150.00.
- One debit-card payment on 2026-07-11; no card return ever: allowance $75.00. Had it been dated 2026-07-10 it would fall outside the three months and the allowance would be nothing.
- Three card payments in the period, but a credit-card payment was charged back in 2025: nothing.
